bullets: Added a scheduled price change for three models, adjusting costs for new sessions starting on October 23, 2026.
Added a managed realtime capability to Sites hosting that lets connected users see live updates and who else is in a room.
Fixed a quality check that incorrectly flagged automatic background files as unauthorized changes to advertiser-funded tasks.
Added a written explanation requirement when reporting ads, and cleared stale report details when logging in or out.
Added a catalog of four informational tips about integrations, themes, sites, and templates that appear in desktop and web apps.
Updated template guidance to read each project's own description and manual instead of forcing a fixed software stack.
Added tools to recognize Google ad clicks and respect browser settings that block tracking.
Updated the ad price suffix to say month and added a new ad option to promote access to GPT-6.1 Sol.
Added Gemini 3.8 Flash to the scheduled pay-as-you-go model prices for new sessions.
Updated settings search to accept a list of specific options to ignore when looking for matches.
Prevented the ads disable command from writing settings in the free version to avoid silently disabling ads in paid sessions.
Added a refusal message for the ads disable command in the free version without writing the setting to disk.
Added fixed rules for desktop project uploads, capping size at 100 MB and file count at 4,000.
Added live label fields to ad fetch telemetry to record the status of model click-history data.
Fixed a spelling error in internal advertising tracking documentation to correct the email field name.
